meta.name: claude-acp
meta.description: Claude Code tier: read-only ~/.claude (auth is via static CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, no refresh cycle, so no write needed on the credentials file itself). Uses its own /tmp/claude-1000 root via CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR - do not share this path with any other tier's profile. Network + filesystem policy now both live here; settings.json.tmpl only supplies the repo path and credential.
